F3: When the user-storage path wins, `createRecoveryCodesCredential` skips `createCredential` and never deletes the old local codes. `UserCredentialManager.isValid` still runs the local validator on input the user storage rejects, so codes from before regeneration keep working.
F4: getCredential` now returns the federated model first, which has no local id. `removeStoredCredentialById` only acts on the local store, and its JPA lookup (`em.find`) throws when the id is null, so an exhausted federated credential is never removed and the call breaks instead.
F5: This is only in the test fixture, whose users always come from its own `users` map. The swallowed `IOException` and the double space are logging and style issues, not product defects.
